say:2:1231106001:1.text: There's no business to speak of in Rustport.
say:2:1231106001:1.source_cn: 锈锚港现在可没有生意。

say:3:1231106002:1.text: Since the port was closed, no imports have come through, and no exports from Rustport have been shipped out.
say:3:1231106002:1.source_cn: 自从港口封锁后，外面的货物进不来，锈锚港的货物出不去。

say:4:1231106003:1.text: All I can do at the moment is pass the time chatting with old customers.
say:4:1231106003:1.source_cn: 我现在只能靠着和老主顾们闲聊来打发时间。

say:5:1231106004:1.text: I wonder if I'll ever be able to get furs from the Ashen Wastes. I've always wanted a warm, cozy blanket!
say:5:1231106004:1.source_cn: 不知道还能不能买到荒角沙漠的皮毛，我一直想要条温暖柔软...
